Task: Click an existing event on the calendar to open an editing form, modify its details (e.g., title, start/end time), and click a 'Save' button.
Expected Result: The selected event on the calendar is updated to reflect the modified details.

expected: The selected event on the calendar is updated to reflect the modified details.
